Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - CI reviews this design-template-only fix.
The proof list leaves TypeScript lint verification to CI, but `.github/workflows/starter-smoke.yml:8–13` excludes every changed path, so neither live starter proof runs on this pull request. The regular Forge workflow does not set `FORGE_STARTER_LIVE`; consequently, `tests/test_database_kinds.py:328–329` bypasses the live runner that executes client lint. This new assertion checks only the forbidden comment and cannot establish the promised lint outcome. Include design-template changes in the smoke workflow's pull-request paths so the named proofs actually run.
